entries.snippet: The indpendent report also says Kirk's aides insisted he speak outdoors, overriding concerns from campus officials.

entries.title: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents

entries.snippet: Northeast states saw rising tides and widespread power outages on Saturday as the storm ripped through the region. Forecasters expect significant winds and rain throughout the weekend.

entries.title: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic
entries.snippet: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections. The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.

entries.title: The AI safety debate is confusing. Here's our guide to the different factions

entries.title: Meal deliveries can save money and improve health. Will they survive Medicaid cuts?
entries.snippet: Some states deliver meals to Medicaid patients that address their dietary needs. Evidence shows it aids recovery and saves healthcare costs, but federal budget cuts may lead some states to cancel it.

entries.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
entries.snippet: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

entries.title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip
entries.snippet: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity. He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.

entries.title: House Democrats plan vast oversight of Trump administration. Impeachment is an option
entries.snippet: "There is a cost to the American people of the out-of-control corruption," said Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries of New York, who is in line to become House speaker if Democrats win control at the Capitol.

entries.title: Hurricane Nolo expected to unleash powerful winds and flash flooding on Hawaii
entries.snippet: While direct landfall by the storm's center was not expected, forecasters said it could cause life-threatening flooding and mudslides, with parts of the Big Island expected to see rainfall totals up to 20 inches.

entries.title: Kennedy Center put off planned repairs despite known structural issues, former employees allege
entries.snippet: The center's executive director and chief operating officer, Matt Floca, did not treat the roofing issues as priorities and in April halted a funded plan to address them, according to the letter Thursday signed by David Seide, a lawyer representing the anonymous whistleblowers.

entries.title: German and Russian foreign ministers have rare meeting at United Nations General Assembly
entries.snippet: Lavrov was dismissive after the German and Russian foreign ministers met Saturday on the sidelines of the meeting, holding what's believed to be the first such tête-à-tête since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

entries.title: Bodies of 6 people, including 4 Americans, recovered from collapsed building in Athens
entries.snippet: The blast on Friday was believed to have been caused by a major gas leak, Athens Mayor Haris Doukas said. Neighboring buildings were damaged and evacuated.

entries.snippet: The turnout testified to the church's lasting influence in France despite declining attendance and secularizing trends that have emptied churches across Europe.

entries.snippet: CNN, a member of the U.S. network video pool that rotates duties shooting and sharing video coverage of the president, reported it had been scheduled to fly aboard the president's plane Saturday for a scheduled visit to a college football game.

entries.snippet: Tens of millions of people were in the path of the nor'easter, which was forecast to affect the Mid-Atlantic area and New England throughout the weekend.

entries.snippet: What happens when the hackers aren't human? That's the question at the center of a public policy debate following disclosures by leading tech companies that their AI models went rogue and hacked into other organizations.

entries.snippet: Until now, Mexico's government did not share comprehensive data on people who have been forced to flee their homes due to ongoing violence in many parts of Mexico, leaving civil society groups piecing together information to get a wider view of the problem.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Backlash over data centers tests Europe's AI ambitions
entries.snippet: Massive data centers needed to run AI are triggering protests across Europe. Their operators counter that they boost digital sovereignty and energy independence.

entries.title: China, US agree to set up channel for AI safety incidents
entries.snippet: Following the summit between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, the two superpowers pledged to set up a "communication channel" for AI incidents and boost coordination on military matters.

entries.title: Trump rejects Iran proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump says he has rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and put an end to hostilities. "I'd like to make a deal, too," he said. "But that deal would not be acceptable."

entries.title: Paris: Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass before huge crowd
entries.snippet: The pope addressed around 700,000 people during a Mass at the Place de la Concorde, near the Champs-Elysees. Leo XIV is on a four-day visit to France.

entries.title: Russia expected to intensify hybrid war on Europe

entries.snippet: It's the first such meeting since Russia launched the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. DW has the latest on day 5 of the UN General Assembly debate.

entries.title: Pakistan: Suicide attack at police stop kills at least 11
entries.snippet: The blast was claimed by the Pakistani Taliban, which has stepped up attacks on Pakistani security forces in recent years.

entries.title: German Olympic Committee names Munich as bid city choice
entries.snippet: Munich has been voted as the city that will bid for the Olympics in 2036, 2040 or 2044. Berlin had been in the running but withdrew on Thursday.

entries.title: Propaganda in Russian schools prepares students to die
entries.snippet: The Russian government wants children to learn about patriotism from an early age. DW spoke to students in Siberia about their views on propaganda, the war in Ukraine and their future.

entries.title: South Korea's gender pay gap grows as women get older
entries.snippet: A new report shows how in South Korea, women on average earn less and have fewer employment opportunities throughout their lives.

entries.title: India news: New Delhi, Islamabad trade accusations at UN General Assembly
entries.snippet: Shehbaz Sharif criticized India's policy on Kashmir and praised Pakistan's military, while New Delhi accused Islamabad of supporting cross-border terrorism. DW has more.

entries.title: Thailand: Bangkok flooding triggers disaster declaration
entries.snippet: Rainfall over the past three days has caused heavy flooding in the Thai capital. A state of disaster has been declared in all 50 districts in Bangkok.

entries.title: OpenAI tools post user images from ChatGPT online
entries.snippet: OpenAI said it found 53 cases in which user-uploaded image links on ChatGPT were shared with third-party websites. The company said it had removed most of these links.

entries.title: White House bars CNN from covering upcoming Trump trip, broadcaster says
entries.snippet: CNN said its journalists have been barred from accompanying President Donald Trump on his upcoming trip to Tennessee. The episode marks the Trump administration's latest salvo against the major cable news network.

entries.title: TikTok agrees to settle with Alabama state over teen safety
entries.snippet: The settlement involves TikTok adding several child safety measures to its platform including time limits and increased parental control. It is similar to a recent settlement competitor Meta had reached.

entries.title: Yemeni leader calls for general mobilization against Houthis
entries.snippet: Amid military escalation with the Iran-backed Houthis, the Saudi-backed head of Yemen's governing body urged his compatriots to join the government forces.

entries.title: Lula or Bolsonaro as president? Brazil gears up to vote
entries.snippet: Brazilians go to the polls on October 4. The front-runners are multilateralist incumbent Lula da Silva and former President Jair Bolsonaro's son, Flavio, who wants to bring Brazil closer to the US and away from China.

entries.title: Germany news: Parliament approves fuel tax cut
entries.snippet: German lawmakers hope to drive down fuel prices by cutting taxes on gas and diesel from October 1. Meanwhile, Germany's defense minister visited Budapest to ramp up defense and military ties.
